advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Include errored tickets in the count passed to _sweep_should_yield so the yield log reports total tickets processed.
evidence: error_ids tickets are counted via `error_ids.append(tid)` but never added to compacted or skipped (compact.py:450-456), so an errored ticket does not advance the reported `done`.
Log at compact.py:375-380 formats `done` as 'yielding after %d ticket(s)'.
advisory.finding: The re-yield progress count passed to _sweep_should_yield (compacted + skipped) excludes errored tickets, so the 'yielding after %d ticket(s)' log line understates how many tickets the sweep actually processed before standing aside.
scenarios: A sweep that errors on several tickets then yields will log a count lower than the number of tickets it truly touched, misleading an operator reading the log.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen test_the_map_argument_is_optional_for_the_rebuild_path to assert the None-default ledger's content (e.g. equals the prebuilt-map ledger, or has expected non-null commit_sha entries) rather than only isinstance(list).
evidence: compact_txn.py:114-119 the None-default path builds its own per-ticket map; a wrong result there still returns a list, so `isinstance(ledger, list)` cannot detect it
test_ledger_is_identical_with_and_without_a_prebuilt_map (line ~196) already asserts `with_map == without` where `without` exercises the None-default path, providing the real regression coverage
advisory.finding: test_the_map_argument_is_optional_for_the_rebuild_path asserts only `isinstance(ledger, list)`, which _build_authorship_ledger returns for essentially any input (even a broken None-default branch producing wrong/empty commit_sha values would still return a list). On its own this assertion is regression-blind to the behavior it claims to guard (the compat contract that the rebuild path builds a correct per-ticket map). The correctness is in fact covered by test_ledger_is_identical_with_and_without_a_prebuilt_map, so this is a minor redundancy/assert-too-little suggestion rather than a coverage gap.
advisory.suggested_fix: Assert the None-default ledger equals the prebuilt-map ledger for the same paths (mirroring the parity test), so the compat test actually verifies the rebuild path builds a correct map.
